import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0021:
# pos = (-0.5, 1.8), heading = 270 (facing -x)
# Cabinet 1 is on the left side of view (which is -y / south relative to pos)
# Let's find corners of the base of cabinet 1 in obs 21:
# Front-right corner of cabinet (closest to camera):
# x in image ~ 190, y ~ 480
img21 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0021.png')

# Front face (white side facing right / towards center of room):
# Let's find lowest pixels of the cabinet:
# The white side panel is xs: 120..190
for y in range(450, 500):
    if img21[y, 185, 0] > 200: # white panel
        pass
    else:
        print('Front-right corner y =', y-1)
        break

# The wood front doors:
for y in range(400, 480):
    if img21[y, 218, 0] > 140 and img21[y, 218, 1] > 150: # floor
        print('Front door corner y =', y-1)
        break

# Back corner against west wall:
for y in range(350, 420):
    if img21[y, 218, 0] > 140 and img21[y, 218, 1] > 150:
        pass

# Let's find all pixels of cabinet in obs 21:
# Top surface is grey [170..200]
# Side is white [240..255]
# Front doors are tan/wood [80..130, 120..160, 140..190]
cab_mask = (img21[:,:,0] > 180) & (img21[:,:,1] > 180) & (img21[:,:,2] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 200) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 300)
c_ys, c_xs = np.where(cab_mask)
print('Cabinet side: xs:', c_xs.min(), c_xs.max(), 'ys:', c_ys.min(), c_ys.max())

# Door mask:
door_mask = (img21[:,:,0] < 120) & (img21[:,:,1] > 120) & (img21[:,:,1] < 180) & (img21[:,:,2] > 140) & (img21[:,:,2] < 200)
d_ys, d_xs = np.where(door_mask)
print('Cabinet doors: xs:', d_xs.min(), d_xs.max(), 'ys:', d_ys.min(), d_ys.max())

# Depths of cabinet:
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
# Near corner: col = 191, row = 482
d_near = f * h / (482 - cy)
dx_near = (191 - cx) * d_near / f
# Far corner of front: col = 221, row = 405
d_far = f * h / (405 - cy)
dx_far = (221 - cx) * d_far / f
print(f'Near corner: d={d_near:.3f}, dx={dx_near:.3f}')
print(f'Far corner: d={d_far:.3f}, dx={dx_far:.3f}')

# World coords (cam pos = (-0.5, 1.8), heading 270):
# world_x = cam_x - d
# world_y = cam_y + dx
near_x, near_y = -0.5 - d_near, 1.8 + dx_near
far_x, far_y = -0.5 - d_far, 1.8 + dx_far
print(f'Near corner world: ({near_x:.3f}, {near_y:.3f})')
print(f'Far corner world: ({far_x:.3f}, {far_y:.3f})')
# Cabinet center is roughly:
cab_x = (near_x + far_x) / 2.0 - 0.25 # inset by half depth
cab_y = (near_y + far_y) / 2.0
print(f'Cabinet center estimate: ({cab_x:.3f}, {cab_y:.3f})')
"
